root_idea.summary: The evidence centers on a protective or defensive structure or projection: the Quranic form denotes strongholds, while Classical Arabic applies related terms to defensive objects, horns, spurs, tools, and pegs.
root_idea.development: The protective branch extends from fortresses to things used for defense and projecting implements; a separate lexical branch concerns poor, seedless, or hollow produce.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the attested singular citation form صِيصَةٌ, with the Quranic plural صَيَاصِي retained as the attested form.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the plural صَيَاصِي in صَيَاصِيهِمْ refers to their fortresses or strongholds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree: to bear dates that have become poor or defective dates called صِيصًا or شِيصًا.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive verb describing the palm and the resulting defective dates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poor or defective dates, the kind called حَشَف; also a dialectal equivalent of شِيصٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal noun and variant form in the terminology of dates.
A separately reported Classical sense of صِيصَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pips of a colocynth lacking kernels and consisting only of husks; by extension, similarly empty pips of melon, cucumber, and comparable plants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to hollow or kernel-less seeds and pips.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weaver’s pointed implement used to make the warp and weft even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported implement is also described as a شوكة.
A projecting anatomical feature of the cock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The horn of a bull, cow, or gazelle; also a horn fixed upon a spear in place of an iron point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural form is used for the horns of cattle; the spear use is an associated implement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden pin or peg used to pull dates from a tightly packed mass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The implement is understood by analogy with an animal’s horn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything used to defend oneself or provide protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broad sense for a protective object or means of defense, distinct from the specific sense ‘fortress’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herdsman who manages and protects his herds or flocks well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized designation for a capable, protective pastor.

cautions: No Maqayis entry was supplied for this root; the root-level orientation is therefore based on the supplied Lane and Mufradat evidence.
The Quranic occurrence is plural صَيَاصِي; the public headword صِيصَةٌ is a normalized singular citation form. Lane also reports uncertainty over the final radical in the related form صِيصِيَةٌ.
